name: icon-creator-ai
description: Ask an image model for many app-icon candidates at once (your own Google or OpenRouter key, at most 3 requests in flight), then turn every candidate into a finished cross-platform icon pack and review all candidates on a contact sheet at 64/32/16 px.

google_api_key.title: Google API key
google_api_key.description: Key from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com/apikey). Used for the Gemini image models. Leave empty to use OpenRouter instead.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Key from openrouter.ai/settings/keys. Used when Google is not configured or when the provider is set to openrouter.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Which provider to use: auto (Google when its key is set, else OpenRouter), google, or openrouter.

model.title: Model
model.description: Optional model override, for example gemini-3-pro-image on Google or google/gemini-3.1-flash-image on OpenRouter. Leave empty for the current Nano Banana 2 model of the provider.
